maya: Heads-up — after switching the fp8-compact profile on canary we see a small but consistent drop on the 'invoice-table-extract' eval. overall accuracy down ~22pts on short prompts (<=64 tokens).

maya: example bad output from canary run: `Invoice #12345
Amount: thirty two dollars` instead of `$32.00` — formatting and numeric hallucination mixed.

devon: ugh. which job id / model variant?

maya: job id `eval-2026-09-12-021` running model redwood-3b-v2-quant-fp8-compact. seed=7, batch_shape=8x128.

tiago: can you paste the exact eval config? batch shape matters a lot for fp8 math noise.

maya: sure — snippet:
```
--model redwood-3b-v2
--quant fp8-compact
--batch-shape 8x128
--seed 7
--task invoice-table-extract
--prompt-truncation short
```

sam: did we compare to fp16 baseline with same batch shape and seed?

maya: yes — baseline fp16 same job id suffix `-fp16` accuracy 94.1% vs fp8 72.2% on the short prompt set. longer prompts (>=256) are fine.

devon: interesting. sounds like seed+batch combo is amplifying token-level rounding error for short contexts. can you run a few quick reproductions with batch_shape=1x64 and seed sweep?

maya: kicked off small matrix: seeds [1,7,42,99], batch_shapes [1x64,1x128,4x128]. eval-bot should post results when done. @tiago fyi

eval-bot: matrix results uploaded -> `s3://evals/canary/2930012345/matrix.csv`

eval-bot: summary:
- fp8-compact / 1x64 / seed=1 -> 91.7%
- fp8-compact / 1x64 / seed=7 -> 92.3%
- fp8-compact / 1x64 / seed=42 -> 90.9%
- fp8-compact / 1x128 / seed=7 -> 74.8%
- fp8-compact / 8x128 / seed=7 -> 72.2%
- fp16 / 8x128 / seed=7 -> 94.1%

tiago: ok that nails it — batch size and sequence packing are the culprits. packing multiple short requests into large batches triggers numerics that break formatting tokens.

sam: any quick mitigation for canary? disable packer for invoice task or force batch_shape=1x64 for deployments serving invoice extractor.

maya: i can apply a per-route config to pin batch_shape=1x64 for '/extract/invoice' on the canary pool and re-run.

devon: also add a guard in Optimize suggestions: if task is table/amount extraction and quant=fp8 then suggest smaller batch shapes. could be a quick docs+console hint.

tiago: long-term we should add a micro-batch accumulation path that avoids cross-request packing for short-prompts, or adjust quant dynamic range for position 0 tokens. but for now per-route pinning + seed-stability tests for releases.

maya: action items: 1) I will pin batch_shape for the route and roll canary. 2) devon will add an Optimize suggestion PR. 3) tiago will add a unit test that fuzzes batch packing for short prompts on fp8 profiles.

sam: :thumbsup: keep notes and screenshots in the eval ticket `EVAL-7123`.

maya: thanks — will update here when canary is re-run.
